verdict.summary: Weekly scoped review (token-optimized), run 2 of the programme after last week's C1 fix. Review gate re-checked all 5 prior criticals (C2-C6) via a capped 5-agent verify squad plus a targeted deep follow-up: C2 (broken canonical) reclassified STILL_TRUE→REGRESSED — the original /freight-broker-roi-calculator/ URL remains a plain 404 with no redirect, and www.rytsense.com (the canonical's target host) was confirmed this run to no longer resolve via DNS at all, which is worse than the original 'wrong-host, signal-splitting' framing (a dead-host canonical, not a live wrong-host one). A deep-dive found robots.txt and all 7 sitemap sub-files clean of the dead host/URL (no confirmed crawl-budget leak), but surfaced an unverified side-finding: the sitemap's replacement URL /rcm-roi-calculator/ rendered near-empty, while a different, non-sitemap URL /us/rcm-ai-roi-calculator/ rendered fully with a clean canonical — QA-gated as provisional, needs a second specialist pass before acting. C3 (fabricated review schema) and C5 (118 orphaned blog posts) both reclassified STILL_TRUE→UNKNOWN this run: C3's core JSON-LD claim remains structurally unverifiable with this environment's tools (WebFetch strips <script> blocks; confirmed a second week running), though the adjacent unsourced '100% Success Rate / 5 Star Rating' visible copy on /software-development-services-usa/ persists unchanged for a second week. C5's literal '118 posts, zero links' wording was contradicted by 3 of 4 sampled posts carrying commercial links (to the non-/us/ tree) — QA-gated as a narrow, non-representative sample that neither confirms nor disproves the '118' figure; a real crawl is needed before that number is restated with confidence, and the finding should be reframed into two precise metrics (any commercial link vs. /us/-tree links specifically). C4 (no security/compliance page) confirmed STILL_TRUE, unchanged in every particular from last week. C6 (SERP volatility, opened last week as NEW) confirmed STILL_TRUE with fresh live GSC data: 28-day clicks -27.4% (vs -28.5% last week, essentially flat), impressions growth slowed to +0.79% (vs +3.3%), and new critical-severity position drops continue appearing on different pages each week (4 critical + 37 warning this week vs 6+39 last week) rather than resolving — this argues against the 'one-time industry event, will self-resolve' reading from last week; GSC data alone cannot settle industry-wide vs. site-specific causation. H1-H4 (high issues) were not re-verified this run — the 5-agent verify cap was spent entirely on the 5 criticals; carried forward unchanged, verify deferred. A full multi-wave /seo-360 crawl was again skipped this run (scoped, token-optimized review); only GSC/GA4 live data and targeted WebFetch spot checks were used. Known environment limitations persisted this run and blocked more than they did last week: device shell access to the user's machine failed outright (Windows-update mount bug), and this session's outbound HTTPS to both rytsensetech-growth-board.pages.dev and rytsensetech.com itself was rejected by org egress policy for raw HTTP/curl — WebFetch (read-only) and the GSC/GA4/GitHub/Slack MCP tools were unaffected and used throughout. As a result, live board writes (POST /api/engagements, POST /api/tasks for C6) could not be completed this run either; this audit.json update was pushed directly via the GitHub API as the documented fallback.

criticalIssues.title: Broken canonical to www.rytsense.com
criticalIssues.detail: Freight broker ROI calculator (and related) canonicalizes to the wrong host, splitting index signals.
criticalIssues.reviewNote: Reclassified STILL_TRUE→REGRESSED 2026-09-22. Verified this run: (1) https://rytsensetech.com/freight-broker-roi-calculator/ still a plain 404, no redirect, unchanged from last week. (2) https://www.rytsense.com/ — the canonical's target host — now confirmed via a clean DNS resolution failure to not resolve at all (last week this was only a single unconfirmed lead). This upgrades the finding from 'wrong-host canonical splitting signals between two live hosts' to 'canonical target host is dead' — a more severe form of the same defect, hence REGRESSED rather than a severity bump within STILL_TRUE. Deep follow-up (crawler-access-engineer) checked robots.txt and all 7 sitemap sub-files directly: neither references www.rytsense.com or the dead URL, and one sampled internal page had no live link to either — so no confirmed sitewide crawl-budget leak, though only 1 of ~600+ URLs was checked for outbound links (not a full crawl). Unverified side-finding (QA-gated, provisional, single-agent, not yet cross-verified): the sitemap's listed replacement URL /rcm-roi-calculator/ rendered near-empty via WebFetch, while a different URL /us/rcm-ai-roi-calculator/ (found by search, not present in the sitemap under that path) rendered fully with a clean self-referencing canonical — possible duplicate-URL/sitemap mismatch. Do not act on a 301-redirect recommendation until a second specialist confirms which URL is authoritative. Board task W1 remains status=in-progress on the live task board.

criticalIssues.reviewNote: Reclassified STILL_TRUE→UNKNOWN 2026-09-22 (schema-level claim is not verifiable one way or the other with this environment's current tools, not evidence it's fixed). WebFetch converts HTML to markdown and cannot see <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks — confirmed again this run (second week running) as a hard tooling limitation; no AggregateRating/review JSON-LD claim can be confirmed or denied by this method. Checked 4 pages this run: /us/machine-learning-development-services/ and /us/ai-development-services/ show only a real, sourced 'Clutch 5.0' link (fine, not fabricated); /us/chatgpt-developers/ is still 404 (unchanged). /software-development-services-usa/ again shows unsourced '⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Star Rating' and '100% Success Rate' visible copy with no adjacent citation — this is the SAME page and SAME issue flagged last week (persistent, not newly found); it is a real, verifiable, actionable trust-copy problem independent of the schema question. Board task W3/C3 remains status=todo (due 2026-09-23) on the live task board. Resolving the underlying schema question requires raw HTML/DOM access (curl, view-source, or a JSON-LD-aware fetch tool) not available in this environment either week so far.

criticalIssues.title: 118 blog posts with zero money-page links
criticalIssues.detail: Large content corpus is commercially orphaned — no internal links into primary service URLs.
criticalIssues.reviewNote: Reclassified STILL_TRUE→UNKNOWN 2026-09-22 — narrow finding only, per QA gate: do not read this as confirming or disproving the '118' figure itself. Sampled 4 blog posts this run (found via search, NOT drawn from the original 118-post list, which is unavailable in this environment) — 3 of 4 carry at least one inline commercial link (all into the non-/us/ global tree, not the /us/ money-page tree specifically), directly contradicting the literal 'zero money-page links' wording for those posts; 1 of 4 is a genuine orphan with no commercial link at all. The specific population sampled cannot confirm or revise the '118' count from the original (unavailable) list — that requires a real crawl. QA-gated recommendation, adopted: reframe this finding before the next full /seo-360 pass into two precise, separately-tracked metrics — (a) posts with zero inline links to ANY commercial/service page on either tree, and (b) posts with zero inline links specifically into the /us/ money-page tree — and do not restate '118' as a verified number in client-facing output until a real crawl re-derives both counts. Board task W5/C5 remains status=todo on the live task board.

criticalIssues.title: Sitewide SERP ranking volatility — multiple high-value queries dropped 40-72 positions in 7 days
criticalIssues.detail: GSC check_alerts (2026-09-14 to 2026-09-20): 6 critical position drops (e.g. "top generative ai companies" on /us/blog/top-generative-ai-development-companies-usa/ fell from position 2 to 73; a healthcare case study fell from 4.5 to 70) plus 39 warning-level drops across global and /us/ pages. Organic clicks -28.5% over 28 days despite impressions +3.3%. GSC URL Inspection on the worst-hit URL shows it remains indexed/crawlable/canonical-matched — no technical defect found there. Independent SEO press reports broad, unnamed Google ranking volatility from 2026-09-15, matching the timing; likely industry-wide rather than a site-caused regression, but worth monitoring given the site's other unresolved trust issues. UPDATE 2026-09-22 (live GSC re-check, 28d window 2026-08-25/2026-09-21 vs prior 28d): clicks 1108 (-27.44%, essentially flat vs last week's -28.5%), impressions 112098 (+0.79%, growth has slowed sharply from +3.3%), CTR 0.99% (down 0.38pp), avg position improved slightly to 30.4 (from 32.4). 7-day alert re-check: 4 critical + 37 warning drops (vs 6 critical + 39 warning last week) — alert count is down slightly, but 3 of this week's 4 criticals are on different queries/pages than last week's named examples (new pages crashing weekly: 'hire programmer india', 'best ai tools for web development', 'custom mobile app dev dubai'), and both of last week's originally-named queries ('top generative ai companies', the healthcare case study) remain fully collapsed with zero recovery signal. This is an ongoing weekly pattern, not a one-time 7-day event — the 'likely industry-wide, may self-resolve' framing from last week is not supported by this week's data (no sign of recovery for the original queries, new pages still getting hit). GSC data alone cannot confirm or rule out industry-wide vs. site-specific causation.
criticalIssues.reviewNote: STILL_TRUE, high confidence on the numbers (all via live GSC MCP tool calls this run, exact figures, explicit date ranges), low-moderate confidence on causal attribution (industry-wide vs. site-specific — not resolvable from GSC data alone). No live board task exists yet for C6 — known gap carried from last run (live-board POST access blocked both weeks by an unrelated infrastructure issue, not a decision to skip); flagged again this run, should be created as soon as board write access is restored.
